## FLUX 3 text to image

One prompt, one FLUX 3 Image call, with the frame set explicitly because `auto` falls back to a square when there is no reference.

`aspect_ratio` is **21:9** and the prompt fills that width — *cliffs on one side, sea on the other*. The ratio and the prompt should agree.

`resolution` is **1k**. Draft at **768sq**, finish at **2k** or **4k**, but a new resolution is a new generation, so the composition can change. For an exact size set `width` and `height` together (256–6256 each, up to 16.8 MP); they override both resolution and aspect ratio.

`grounding` is **on**: the prompt may be researched with web and image search first. Turn it off for a request that should be read literally.

FLUX 3 Image has no negative prompt. Describe what should be there instead: *an empty promenade*, not *no crowds*.

`variation` is not sent to the API — flux-3-image has no seed. It is **fixed** here so a rerun with nothing changed costs nothing; bump it (or set it to *randomize*) for a fresh take. `expanded_prompt` is `result.prompt`, the prompt the model actually used after expanding yours.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** node feeds the prompt in this graph, so there is one
place to edit it. It emits a plain string, **not** a list. That is the difference between it and **Prompt
List**, which would make each node it feeds run once per line and multiply what the graph
costs.
